newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's confirms Aa1 for Telecom NZ.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's confirms Aa1 for Telecom NZ.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it has confirmed the Aa1 ratings on long term debt issues by Telecom Corp of New Zealand Ltd and guaranteed subsidiaries.
"This concludes a review initiated on November 14, 1996 in response to Telecom's announcement of a NZ$1 billion share buyback," Moody's said. About NZ$1 billion of debt is affected.
Moody's said leverage will increase initially and debt protection measures will decline as a result of the external financing needed to fund the buyback.

"However, the company's strong and stable cash generation characteristics will permit gradual improvements after providing for the company's high dividend payout and capital expenditure programme," the ratings agency said.
Moody's said it expected Telecom to finance the share buyback using external financing, which will lead to an overall decline in debt protection measurements.
"Proforma financial leverage will likely exceed 50 percent and interest coverage will decline to approximately six times in the near term as a result of the additional interest burden," Moody's said.
The agency said Telecom had successfuly met the challenges of a non-regulated environment through attention to service quality and cost controls.
"This has been reflected in the significant improvement in operating results during the past several years," it said.

"While its market share in key segments is likely to decline over the intermediate term, market growth and ongoing cost containment should permit the company to continue to generate strong returns," it said.
"However, the share repurchase has substantially reduced Telecom's flexibility to sustain and absorb unanticipated operational and financial stress," Moody's said.
Telecom Corporation of New Zealand Ltd - Aa1 rating on senior unsecured notes and Aa1 counterparty rating
TCNZ Finance Ltd - Aa1 rating on backed senior unsecured notes
Telecom Corporation of New Zealand (Overseas Finance) Ltd - Aa1 on backed senior unsecured notes
Telecom Corporation of New Zealand's Prime-1 short term rating was not under review.
